request.subject: RM_Danglemaw

edits.change: One jaw anatomy on every facing: a hinged, lipless jaw with a broad upper jaw and a continuous, U-shaped lower jaw, hanging straight down at the end of the cord. The same jaw is drawn on every view; only the viewing angle changes.

South view: front view, the jaw seen from the front with its continuous lower jaw rim curving beneath the mouth. East view: the same jaw in profile, upper jaw and continuous lower jaw hinged at the back, in side silhouette. North view: the same jaw seen from behind, with its continuous lower jaw rim curving along the bottom.

North view is a rear view, seen from behind: the smooth outer muscle of the back of the jaw and the closed rear hinge are visible, the mouth opening and teeth face away from the viewer on the far side, and the lower end is a single rounded, closed silhouette.
North view shows the exterior rear surface of the hanging jaw, one unbroken rounded shape of dark muscle, with the cord entering from above.

invariants: Bare muscular cord like a stretched tendon: no scales, no torso, uniform thickness along its length
Upper end rooted directly into the Eyebark canopy, entering from the top of the frame without coiling or wrapping a branch
Free end is only a jaw with no head behind it: no eyes, no skull shape, no neck
Hangs slack and straight down under its own weight
No limbs and no tail tip; the cord runs from the anchor to the jaw and nothing else
Transparent background, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, drawSize 1.7
request.prompt: A single RimWorld creature sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background: the danglemaw, a mouth on a tendon. The body is a bare muscular cord like a stretched tendon, smooth pinkish-grey muscle with fine fibre lines, the same thickness from top to bottom, with no scales, no torso and no thickening into a trunk. Its upper end is rooted directly into the Eyebark canopy, entering from the top edge of the picture as a flesh-coloured cord growing out of the bark. The cord hangs slack and perfectly straight down under its own weight, vertical and relaxed. At the free end is a jaw and nothing else: a hinged, lipless jaw with a broad upper jaw and a continuous, U-shaped lower jaw, hanging straight down, with a row of small pale teeth along the inside of the jaw edges and a pale interior. There is no head behind the jaw, no eyes, no skull shape and no neck; the cord joins the jaw at its hinge. The creature has no limbs and no tail tip. One jaw design is used in every view, and only the angle changes. South view: front view, eyes-free jaw seen from the front, mouth opening toward the viewer, the continuous lower jaw rim curving beneath the mouth. East view: side profile of the same jaw, upper jaw and continuous lower jaw meeting at the hinge in side silhouette. North view: rear view, seen from behind: the smooth outer muscle of the back of the jaw and its closed rear hinge are visible, the mouth opening and teeth face away from the viewer on the far side, and the lower end reads as one unbroken rounded shape with the cord entering from above. Colour palette identical across views: muted pink-grey muscle cord, darker maroon outer jaw, pale cream teeth and interior.
